items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I think I saw him once or twice in Kansas City. But, somehow, I wasn't just -- probably so prejudiced in favor of Kansas City bands.

ctx.x: Well, I mean, everybody says that it was -- well, Hawk always used to say the records didn't do the band justice, and I'm sure that's true.

Well, I don't think we had a chance to hear them too much on the air. I might have heard him, but I don't have anything that reminds me of Fletcher. I think I saw him once or twice in Kansas City. But, somehow, I wasn't just -- probably so prejudiced in favor of Kansas City bands. Maybe it was that. Because I know they had played Kansas City at night when they had the jam sessions.
Well, there wasn't quite -- what we're really talking about with Kansas City, is a sort of looseness, really, isn't it?
